svg.title: Beacon secure CI/CD architecture
svg.desc: The repository, pull-request, protected-main, artifact-promotion, environment-approval, production-verification, rollback, and evidence boundaries.

g.text: BEACON 10/10 SECURE CI/CD AND AI DELIVERY ARCHITECTURE
Astro + Markdoc · GitHub Actions · Cloudflare · Claude/Codex · Human-controlled production
0. SECURITY FOUNDATION — THREAT MODEL BEFORE PIPELINE
GitHub · Cloudflare · AI context · audit evidence
1. CONTROLLED REQUEST, AI AGENTS AND PRIVILEGED CHANGE GOVERNANCE
Treat repository, issues, PR comments, logs and web content as untrusted.
Redact secrets, minimize context, block arbitrary tool/network access.
AGENTS.md · CLAUDE.md · workflows · package scripts · adapters · approvals · infrastructure
No production credentials · no self-approval · no merge bypass · no deployment authority ·
no disabling tests or security gates.
feature/BEA-* → pull request → squash merge → protected main
Lockfile required · controlled updates · license policy · package-age and maintainer review
No pull_request_target execution of untrusted code · no mutable actions · no latest installs
MFA · least privilege · periodic access review · no shared accounts · separate machine identities
3. UNTRUSTED PULL-REQUEST CI — READ-ONLY AND SECRETLESS
Secret exposure · failed build/tests · critical/high exploitable dependency · serious/critical axe issue ·
workflow policy violation · unverified artifact · production credential exposure
Heuristic SAST result · architecture hotspot · complexity increase · noncritical dependency issue ·
performance regression · incomplete manual accessibility validation
Optional evaluation only until commercial licensing is confirmed.
Non-blocking; never replaces CodeQL, dependency review, tests or human judgment.
Cannot merge · cannot approve · cannot access staging/production secrets · cannot alter protected settings ·
cannot mark its own work complete
Build once. Promote the same verified artifact through preview, staging and production.
Ephemeral URL · mock/test integrations · no production customer data · automatic expiry.
Artifact · digest · SBOM · attestation · test reports · SARIF · screenshots · approval record.
Required checks + independent review + human approval + docs impact complete.
5. CONTROLLED DELIVERY — STAGING, PRODUCTION AND ROLLBACK
Separate staging and production API tokens.
Store only in protected GitHub environments.
Scope to the minimum account/resource permissions and rotate regularly.
One production deployment at a time.
No overlapping releases. Cancel stale staging jobs safely.
Preserve evidence, classify incident and revoke exposed credentials.
Redeploy last known-good verified artifact or revert the protected-main commit.
Repeat post-deploy verification before service is declared restored.
Target RTO: 60 minutes · Target RPO: near-zero for source/configuration · validate against actual business needs
Production verification + audit evidence + Markdoc/ADR/runbook/roadmap update
Documented emergency owner · time-limited access · mandatory incident record · retrospective review
WCAG 2.2 AA engineering target · keyboard and screen-reader support · reduced motion · no unsafe HTML injection ·
content remains usable without animation and at 320 CSS pixels.
Google Fonts · Turnstile · email provider · analytics reviewed for CSP, privacy, availability and data handling.
Minimize external scripts and document every processor.
Environment-specific configuration · no debug mode · safe error messages · secure CORS · no source maps containing secrets ·
Contact-form abuse · injection · open redirects · header checks · rate-limit behavior · dependency and endpoint review.
7. CONTINUOUS ASSURANCE, INCIDENT RESPONSE AND BUSINESS CONTINUITY
Severity classification · owner and escalation · evidence preservation · credential revocation · Cloudflare rollback ·
GitHub token/session review · notification decision · root cause · corrective actions.
Deployment frequency · change failure rate · MTTR · vulnerability age · secret incidents · failed gates ·
rollback success · accessibility regressions · dependency freshness.
Workflow logs · approvals · deployment history · SARIF · SBOM · provenance · incident reports · exception decisions.
Markdoc records current state only after verified implementation.
Architecture, ADR, runbook and roadmap changes are part of completion.
Flow · IAM · dependencies · PPE · credentials · integrity · logging
Least privilege · SHA pinning · environment gates · attestations
Operating principle: AI proposes and implements · deterministic controls validate · humans own risk and authorize production · verified artifacts are promoted
